verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection gateway, so org usage analytics is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents connections, OAuth, token scoping, namespaces, publishing and triggers. None of it mentions dashboards or metrics for call volumes, users, errors or cost on consumed or published servers.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost
